payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-09-02 (offline repo read plus a browser run on main at 45a3dca; no provider access). The 2026-08-21 note is superseded on three points. (1) BOTH flags default ON, not off: src/lib/env.ts:225-228 declares RAG_INCREMENTAL_EVIDENCE_PREVIEW with .default("true"), and src/lib/client-env.ts:18-22 returns value !== "false", so an unset NEXT_PUBLIC_RAG_INCREMENTAL_EVIDENCE_PREVIEW_RENDER renders the rail. The .env.example:158 line is commented because unset means ON. docs/verified-answer-incremental-delivery-design.md records Phase 1 shipped and enabled by default on 2026-08-27. (2) The browser proof the row asked for already exists and was RUN: tests/answer-progress-ui-smoke.spec.ts:623 'the sources arrive during the wait and hand over to the answer's own rail' and :685 'the arriving sources are paced apart, and are simply present when motion is suppressed', both chromium, result '2 passed (12.4s)'. That spec does not match tests/ui-*.spec.ts, which is why earlier ui-* searches missed it; it is named explicitly in playwright.config.ts productionSpecPattern and testMatch, so it runs in verify:ui and the full release matrix. The open question 'whether the render path is actually exercised by a UI journey' is therefore answered yes. (3) Offline companion coverage also exists: tests/answer-evidence-preview.dom.test.tsx:46-53 pins the client gate truth table in both directions. REMAINING OFFLINE SCOPE, narrowed to two uncovered assertions: no browser assertion of the false rollback (the value is inlined at build time per src/lib/client-env.ts:16, so flipping it needs a rebuild and it may be right to leave that at unit level and say so), and the danger-level source-governance suppression at src/lib/answer-preview.ts:40 is only unit-covered (tests/answer-incremental-delivery.test.ts:187,194). That gap is route-level, not browser-level: answer-preview.ts is server-only and the browser spec drives the rail through a mocked SSE stream, so a Playwright test structurally cannot observe the suppression - closing it needs a real /api/answer stream over a danger-governed corpus, which is provider-backed. A stale doc comment at src/components/clinical-dashboard/answer-status.tsx claiming the preview is 'off by default' was corrected in the same change. Phase 2 stays unbuilt and provider-gated.
